name: trespasser
source:
117/400 Garcia Street (1) completed construction in 2017 and began accepting tenants the following year. This makes it one of the oldest buildings in the city still operating for its original purpose.

The metal had been part of it from the start, though for the longest time it remained inert.

[From [url=https://unseconds.itch.io/trespasser]Itch.io[/url]]
